questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Priya washes her clothes in the evening.

options.text: The clothes was washed by Priya in the evening.
The clothes is washed by Priya in the evening.
The clothes are washed by Priya in the evening.
The clothes were washed by Priya in the evening.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The clothes are washed by Priya in the evening.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and we need to change it to the passive form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the simple present tense.
 
• The simple present tense in the active voice has the following structure: **Subject + V1+s/es+ object__**
 
• The simple present tense in the passive voice has the following structure: **__Object+ is/am/are+ V3+ by + subject__**
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Active voice - *He reads a novel.*
 
• Passive voice - *A novel is read.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Passive Voice: *The clothes are washed by Priya in the evening.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. A panther is reported to have broken into a house yesterday in search of food and shelter.

B. The villagers heard his cries and ran to the house but the scared animal had run away through the window by then.

C. It secretly slouched into a room where a young man named Johnny was sleeping, who suddenly woke up and realized that the beast was roaming around his bed.

D. Just as the panther was about to leap on him, he swiftly shot out of bed and hid in a closet.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "ACDB"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement A is the opening sentence of the passage which explains that yesterday, a panther reportedly broke inside a residence in search of food and refuge.
 
• Statement C is the second sentence of the passage which explains that it crouched stealthily into a room where a young guy named Johnny was fast asleep. Johnny abruptly awoke to see the beast prowling around his bed.
 
• Statement D is the third sentence of the passage which explains he quickly sprang out of bed and hid in a closet just as the panther was ready to lunge at him.
 
• Statement B is the last sentence of the passage which shows that the terrified animal had already fled through the window when the locals arrived at the house after hearing his cries.

Hence, the correct sequence is A, C, D, B

The correct answer is option 3.

The correct passage is: ***A**. A panther is reported to have broken into a house yesterday in search of food and shelter. **C**. It secretly slouched into a room where a young man named Johnny was sleeping, who suddenly woke up and realized that the beast was roaming around his bed. **D**. Just as the panther was about to leap on him, he swiftly shot out of bed and hid in a closet. **B**. The villagers heard his cries and ran to the house but the scared animal had run away through the window by then.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

He said that something might be missing in there.

options.text: He said, "Something may be missing in here."
He said, "Something had to be missing in there."
He said, "Something is been missing in here."
He said, "Something could be missing in here."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **He said, "Something may be missing in here."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reported verb 'said' remains unchanged in the reporting speech part.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The modal verb 'might' in the indirect part changes to 'may' in the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *He said, "Something may be missing in here."*
